body:
### Summary

I'm migrating one of our work projects to Python 3.15. The migration appears successful, I haven't run into issues locally or on the Ubuntu runner in Azure DevOps, but `windows-latest` seems to consistently fail to download Python.

```txt
Running: uv sync --no-build-isolation-package internal_package
error: Failed to download `[https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/20261009/cpython-3.15.0%2B20261009-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-install_only_stripped.tar.gz`](https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/20261009/cpython-3.15.0%2B20261009-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-install_only_stripped.tar.gz%60)
  cause: error sending request for url (https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/20261009/cpython-3.15.0%2B20261009-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-install_only_stripped.tar.gz)
  cause: client error (Connect)
  cause: invalid peer certificate: UnknownIssuer
```

For comparison, this is from `ubuntu-latest`:

```txt
Running: uv sync --no-build-isolation-package internal_package
Downloading cpython-3.15.0-linux-x86_64-gnu (download) (35.9MiB)
 Downloaded cpython-3.15.0-linux-x86_64-gnu (download)
Using CPython 3.15.0
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
Resolved 55 packages in 0.91ms
```

The pipeline is currently using `uv` version `0.13.0` (in practice the pipeline installs it via `python -m pip install --user uv` from an internal PyPI mirror, so `0.13.1` would be used if it was available there). I don't know if this is something `0.13.1` has already fixed and I just need to wait for the cooldown to pass, but I figured I'd ask anyway.

### Platform

Windows Server 2025

### Version

0.13.0

### Python version

Python 3.15.0
title: `uv` fails to download Python 3.15 in CI for Windows, but works fine on Ubuntu
